partnerValue.title: What your brand gets access to
partnerValue.subtitle: Built for brands serious about the Spanish-language luxury consumer.
partnerValue.item1Title: A consumer no generalist network reaches
partnerValue.item1Desc: Our audience is the high-net-worth Spanish-speaking consumer — in Spain, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, and across Latin America. They read in Spanish by choice, not necessity. They are not an afterthought in your existing campaigns. They are the entire point of ours.
partnerValue.item2Desc: Your brand appears within genuine editorial content produced by specialist writers who live and understand luxury in their market. Not banner ads. Not paid listings. Contextual placement that earns trust from a reader who is already interested in what you sell.
partnerValue.item3Desc: A single partnership with Dominios de Lujo gives your brand placement potential across the largest exact-match Spanish luxury domain portfolio in existence — across travel, jewelry, fashion, real estate, gastronomy, wellness, and more.
partnerValue.item4Title: Brand safety guaranteed by editorial standard
partnerValue.item4Desc: Every site in our network publishes under the LujoTotal™ editorial standard — a quality framework that governs tone, accuracy, and presentation. Your brand will not appear next to thin content, misleading claims, or anything that puts your reputation at risk.
partnerValue.item5Desc: We handle integration, placement, and ongoing content. What we need from your team is an affiliate approval and brand assets. That is the full extent of the ask. Everything else is ours to manage.
